tasks.label: PC: build + test
tasks.command: make -C micropython/ports/unix USER_C_MODULES=$HOME/xpython/modules && for t in tests/test_*.py; do MICROPYPATH=$HOME/xpython/modules/xfw:$HOME/xpython/modules/xsfs:$HOME/xpython/modules/xloader:$HOME/xpython/modules/xexec:$HOME/xpython/modules/xnet:$HOME/xpython/modules/xota:.frozen micropython/ports/unix/build-standard/micropython $t || exit 1; done

tasks.label: ESP32: build + flash
tasks.command: source esp-idf/export.sh > /dev/null && make -C micropython/ports/esp32 BOARD=XPY_ESP32 BOARD_DIR=$HOME/xpython/boards/XPY_ESP32 USER_C_MODULES=$HOME/xpython/modules/micropython.cmake PORT=/dev/ttyUSB0 deploy

tasks.label: ESP32: run tests
tasks.command: for t in tests/test_*.py; do mpremote connect /dev/ttyUSB0 run $t || exit 1; done

tasks.label: ESP32: build
tasks.command: source esp-idf/export.sh > /dev/null && make -C micropython/ports/esp32 BOARD=XPY_ESP32 BOARD_DIR=$HOME/xpython/boards/XPY_ESP32 USER_C_MODULES=$HOME/xpython/modules/micropython.cmake
